This is a senior-level Python software engineering role (8+ years of experience) at Voxel51, working on their AI data platform for computer vision datasets. The work spans their open-source SDK, enterprise APIs, backend systems, and UIs, with a focus on scaling to petabyte-size unstructured image and video datasets deployed in customer cloud and on-premises environments. The core stack is Python with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB, Elasticsearch), plus TypeScript as a secondary skill.
